Cockroach Janta Party's Abhijeet Dipke has apologised to Punjabi singer-actor Diljit Dosanjh following their months-long disagreement.
Months later, Diljit addressed the criticism at his Delhi concert at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, saying nobody should teach Punjabis how to fight. He also spoke about the mockery of his film on Jaswant Singh Khalra.
